description: This file defines the WebResponse class and related enums and nested classes for handling HTTP responses, including serialization/deserialization, status codes, and response headers within the WPEFramework Web namespace.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with serialization/deserialization capabilities, headers, status codes, and body management.

classes.name: Response::Serializer
classes.description: Abstract class for serializing Response objects.

classes.name: Response::Deserializer
classes.description: Abstract class for deserializing Response objects.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Serializes a Response object into a string.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a Response object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the Response object has a valid error code.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the Response object to default state.

methods.name: Body
methods.description: Sets or gets the body of the response.

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Sets or gets the serialization mode.
